info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Multi Sites API
info.description: The MultiSites API lets you request the key metrics (visits, page views, revenue) for all Websites in Matomo.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.
(Required) The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).
Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.
Username used internally to restrict the visible sites while a scheduled task is running.
`true` to include additional goal and ecommerce metrics, `false` to return the default metric set.
Site name or site ID pattern used to limit the matched websites.
Metric columns to include, either as a comma-separated list or an array of metric names.

request.description: Returns a report displaying the total visits, actions and revenue, as well as the evolution of these values, of all existing sites over a specified period of time.

response.name:
Report rows for each matched site, including evolution metrics when available.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.
